key_dispute: Two ambiguities. (1) next_legal_action: STATE.md's NEXT line says the only legal next action is NONE/HOLD (NEXT_ACTION_OWNER=NONE, HOLD_NO_ACTION) and that EXP-005's recomputation is already done with max |delta| 0.0, so the key's 'zero-new-fit re-analysis over RUN-002 predictions' is neither the project's declared next action nor a new step. Fair reading: read-only re-verification is not within STOPPED_SCOPE (which bars new models/transforms/ablations/new prediction analyses/retuning) and 'necessary scientific evidence audit' is inside the 2026-11-15 grant, so it is permissible but should be labelled an audit/re-check, not 'the next legal action'; the literal NEXT=NONE should not be silently overridden. Both answers effectively chose this reading, so neither is penalised. (2) bindable: 'bindable' can mean (a) the Run record binds to a Run identity (feedback_link binder -> RUN_RECORD_BOUND once MAX_RUN_RECORD_BYTES was raised from 128 KiB to 4 MiB) or (b) the Run is attestable through the registered event/hash chain (run_integrity verify-run -> RUN_HISTORY_NOT_ATTESTABLE / HISTORY_SOURCES_MISSING). The frozen bundle holds only metrics.json with no registry, manifest or predictions.jsonl, and contains no trace of the 128 KiB->4 MiB cap change (it exists only in the runtime source, pdrw_agent/science/feedback_link.py), so an answer working strictly from the bundle can defensibly land on either. Scored per the key's reading (a) = true, but answer_2's false is a definitional disagreement with a real tool output, not a fabrication; a grader adopting reading (b) would invert the two Run verdicts.
